warnings.message: Fetched web content ends at the tool that fetched it; no adapter passes it on to another agent, so the propagation path FH-006 needs can't occur.
No adapter emits the interpretIntent verb.
No adapter emits the retry verb.
Each tool's effect ends at its own output or data asset, so no path passes through two side-effect tools.
Declare `capability_kinds: [deployRelease]` (or `moveResource`) on the tool; no tool name maps to these verbs.
Declare `recipient_type: public_channel` (or `broadcast`) on the output the agent sends to.
Declare `trust_level: trusted_core` on the agent named in `delegates_to`.
Declare `exposure_boundary: external` on the agent and `authentication_scope: elevated` on a tool it can reach.
Declare `boundary: external` (or `trust_level: untrusted`) on the data asset being read.
Memory nodes are private by default; declare `shared: true` on memory that more than one agent uses.
